    # Preserve user cache values, including lists and package locations, without
    # shell/list re-interpretation or forwarding CMake's private build-tree state.
    function(_ecosystem_bracket result value)
        set(equal "=")
        string(FIND "${value}" "]${equal}]" found)
        while(NOT found EQUAL -1)
            string(APPEND equal "=")
            string(FIND "${value}" "]${equal}]" found)
        endwhile()
        set(${result} "[${equal}[${value}]${equal}]" PARENT_SCOPE)
    endfunction()
    get_cmake_property(_ecosystem_cache_variables CACHE_VARIABLES)
    set(_ecosystem_cache "")
    foreach(key IN LISTS _ecosystem_cache_variables)
        get_property(type CACHE "${key}" PROPERTY TYPE)
        if(type MATCHES "^(INTERNAL|STATIC)$" OR key MATCHES "^ECOSYSTEM_FACADE_")
            continue()
        endif()
        if(type STREQUAL "UNINITIALIZED")
            set(type STRING)
        endif()
        _ecosystem_bracket(name "${key}")
        _ecosystem_bracket(value "${${key}}")
        string(APPEND _ecosystem_cache "set(${name} ${value} CACHE ${type} \"Forwarded by the facade\" FORCE)\n")
    endforeach()
    file(WRITE "${_ecosystem_state}/cache.in" "${_ecosystem_cache}")

    file(WRITE "${_ecosystem_state}/entry.cmake" [==[
foreach(name mvp mvp.exe)
    set(destination "${OUTER}/${name}")
    set(marker "${OUTER}/CMakeFiles/ecosystem-${name}.owned")
    if(EXISTS "${marker}")
        file(REMOVE "${destination}" "${marker}")
    endif()
    set(source "${INNER}/${name}")
    if(EXISTS "${source}")
        if(WIN32)
            file(CREATE_LINK "${source}" "${destination}" COPY_ON_ERROR)
        else()
            file(RELATIVE_PATH relative "${OUTER}" "${source}")
            file(CREATE_LINK "${relative}" "${destination}" SYMBOLIC)
        endif()
        file(WRITE "${marker}" "generated\n")
    endif()
endforeach()
]==])
    file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${_ecosystem_state}/entry-$<CONFIG>.cmake"
        CONTENT "string(SHA256 config_id \"$<CONFIG>\")\nset(INNER \"${_ecosystem_state}/\${config_id}/consumer\")\nset(OUTER \"${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}\")\ninclude(\"${_ecosystem_state}/entry.cmake\")\n")
    add_custom_command(TARGET _ecosystem_facade_kcuckoounter POST_BUILD
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -P "${_ecosystem_state}/entry-$<CONFIG>.cmake"
        VERBATIM)
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY ADDITIONAL_CLEAN_FILES
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mvp" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mvp.exe"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CMakeFiles/ecosystem-mvp.owned"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CMakeFiles/ecosystem-mvp.exe.owned")

    file(WRITE "${_ecosystem_state}/install.in" [==[
string(SHA256 config_id "${CMAKE_INSTALL_CONFIG_NAME}")
# Installing an outer library must also make its provider closure available to
# another visitor. Each provider delegates recursively through its own facade.
include("@_ecosystem_state@/${config_id}/install-providers.cmake")
foreach(provider IN LISTS providers)
    execute_process(COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" --install "${provider}"
        --config "${CMAKE_INSTALL_CONFIG_NAME}" --prefix "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}"
        RESULT_VARIABLE result)
    if(NOT result STREQUAL "0")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Facade provider installation failed at ${provider}: ${result}")
    endif()
endforeach()
execute_process(COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" --install
    "@_ecosystem_state@/${config_id}/consumer"
    --config "${CMAKE_INSTALL_CONFIG_NAME}" --prefix "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}"
    RESULT_VARIABLE result)

    message(FATAL_ERROR "Facade consumer installation failed: ${result}")
endif()
]==])
    configure_file("${_ecosystem_state}/install.in" "${_ecosystem_state}/install.cmake" @ONLY)
    install(SCRIPT "${_ecosystem_state}/install.cmake")
    return()

project(kcuckoounter VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

endif ()

function(ecosystem_apply_defaults target_name)
    get_target_property(target_type ${target_name} TYPE)
    set(target_scope PRIVATE)
    if (target_type STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY")
        set(target_scope INTERFACE)
    endif ()

    if (MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${target_name} ${target_scope} /W4 /WX)
    elseif (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
        target_compile_options(${target_name}
                ${target_scope}
                -Wall
                -Wextra
                -Wpedantic
                -Wconversion
                -Wsign-conversion
                -Wshadow
                -Werror
                "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-Wnon-virtual-dtor>"
        )
    endif ()

    if (ECOSYSTEM_ENABLE_COVERAGE AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${target_name}
                ${target_scope}
                -fprofile-instr-generate
                -fcoverage-mapping
        )
        target_link_options(${target_name}
                ${target_scope}
                -fprofile-instr-generate
                -fcoverage-mapping
        )
    endif ()
endfunction()
# Runtime ownership is independent of Git: reserved cache directories are never
# payloads, while other authored/source-generated files keep their category paths.
function(_ecosystem_asset_cache_directory path result)
    if ("${path}" MATCHES [=[(^|/)(\.cache|\.[^/]*_cache)(/|$)]=])
        set(${result} TRUE PARENT_SCOPE)
    else ()
        set(${result} FALSE PARENT_SCOPE)
    endif ()
endfunction()

function(_ecosystem_asset_resolve project_root path directory result cached)
    if (NOT EXISTS "${path}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing runtime asset or dangling link: ${path}")
    endif ()
    get_filename_component(real_path "${path}" REALPATH)
    file(RELATIVE_PATH relative_path "${project_root}" "${real_path}")
    if (IS_ABSOLUTE "${relative_path}" OR relative_path MATCHES "^\\.\\.(/|$)")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Runtime asset escapes its project: ${path}")
    endif ()
    if (NOT directory)
        get_filename_component(relative_path "${relative_path}" DIRECTORY)
    endif ()
    _ecosystem_asset_cache_directory("${relative_path}" is_cache)
    set(${result} "${real_path}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(${cached} "${is_cache}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(_ecosystem_asset_walk project_root directory ancestors result)
    _ecosystem_asset_resolve("${project_root}" "${directory}" TRUE real_directory cached)
    if (cached)
        set(${result} "" PARENT_SCOPE)
        return()
    endif ()
    if (real_directory IN_LIST ancestors)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Cyclic runtime asset directory: ${directory}")
    endif ()
    list(APPEND ancestors "${real_directory}")
    if (CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
        file(GLOB children LIST_DIRECTORIES TRUE "${directory}/*")
    else ()
        file(GLOB children LIST_DIRECTORIES TRUE CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${directory}/*")
    endif ()
    set(files)
    foreach (child IN LISTS children)
        if (IS_DIRECTORY "${child}")
            get_filename_component(name "${child}" NAME)
            _ecosystem_asset_cache_directory("${name}" cached)
            if (NOT cached)
                _ecosystem_asset_walk("${project_root}" "${child}" "${ancestors}" nested)
                list(APPEND files ${nested})
            endif ()
        else ()
            _ecosystem_asset_resolve("${project_root}" "${child}" FALSE real_file cached)
            if (NOT cached)
                list(APPEND files "${child}")
            endif ()
        endif ()
    endforeach ()
    set(${result} "${files}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(_ecosystem_runtime_asset_files asset_source result)
    if (NOT EXISTS "${asset_source}" AND NOT IS_SYMLINK "${asset_source}")
        set(${result} "" PARENT_SCOPE)
        return()
    endif ()
    if (NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${asset_source}" OR IS_SYMLINK "${asset_source}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid runtime asset source: ${asset_source}")
    endif ()
    get_filename_component(project_root "${asset_source}/.." REALPATH)
    get_filename_component(real_source "${asset_source}" REALPATH)
    set(files)
    set(allowed_categories brand reports dataset dumps sets templates)
    set(categories ${allowed_categories})
    if (ARGN)
        set(categories ${ARGN})
    endif ()
    foreach (category IN LISTS categories)
        if (NOT category IN_LIST allowed_categories)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid runtime asset category: ${category}")
        endif ()
        if (IS_SYMLINK "${asset_source}/${category}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Runtime asset category uses a symlink: ${category}")
        endif ()
        if (EXISTS "${asset_source}/${category}")
            if (NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${asset_source}/${category}")
                message(FATAL_ERROR "Runtime asset category is not a directory: ${category}")
            endif ()
            _ecosystem_asset_walk("${project_root}" "${asset_source}/${category}" "${real_source}" nested)
            list(APPEND files ${nested})
        endif ()
    endforeach ()
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES files)
    list(SORT files)
    set(${result} "${files}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# Retire only reserved cache directories previously staged by an older surface.
# Never follow output directory aliases or remove similarly named regular files.
function(_ecosystem_prune_asset_caches directory)
    file(GLOB children LIST_DIRECTORIES TRUE "${directory}/*")
    foreach (child IN LISTS children)
        if (IS_DIRECTORY "${child}")
            get_filename_component(name "${child}" NAME)
            _ecosystem_asset_cache_directory("${name}" cached)
            if (cached)
                if (IS_SYMLINK "${child}")
                    file(REMOVE "${child}")
                else ()
                    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${child}")
                endif ()
            elseif (NOT IS_SYMLINK "${child}")
                _ecosystem_prune_asset_caches("${child}")
            endif ()
        endif ()
    endforeach ()
endfunction()

function(ecosystem_stage_assets target_name)
    file(GENERATE
            OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ecosystem_assets_${target_name}_$<CONFIG>.cmake"
            CONTENT [==[# Script mode has its own policy scope; it does not inherit the project policy.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
# Runtime ownership is independent of Git: reserved cache directories are never
# payloads, while other authored/source-generated files keep their category paths.
function(_ecosystem_asset_cache_directory path result)
    if ("${path}" MATCHES [=[(^|/)(\.cache|\.[^/]*_cache)(/|$)]=])
        set(${result} TRUE PARENT_SCOPE)
    else ()
        set(${result} FALSE PARENT_SCOPE)
    endif ()
endfunction()

function(_ecosystem_asset_resolve project_root path directory result cached)
    if (NOT EXISTS "${path}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing runtime asset or dangling link: ${path}")
    endif ()
    get_filename_component(real_path "${path}" REALPATH)
    file(RELATIVE_PATH relative_path "${project_root}" "${real_path}")
    if (IS_ABSOLUTE "${relative_path}" OR relative_path MATCHES "^\\.\\.(/|$)")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Runtime asset escapes its project: ${path}")
    endif ()
    if (NOT directory)
        get_filename_component(relative_path "${relative_path}" DIRECTORY)
    endif ()
    _ecosystem_asset_cache_directory("${relative_path}" is_cache)
    set(${result} "${real_path}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(${cached} "${is_cache}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(_ecosystem_asset_walk project_root directory ancestors result)
    _ecosystem_asset_resolve("${project_root}" "${directory}" TRUE real_directory cached)
    if (cached)
        set(${result} "" PARENT_SCOPE)
        return()
    endif ()
    if (real_directory IN_LIST ancestors)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Cyclic runtime asset directory: ${directory}")
    endif ()
    list(APPEND ancestors "${real_directory}")
    if (CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
        file(GLOB children LIST_DIRECTORIES TRUE "${directory}/*")
    else ()
        file(GLOB children LIST_DIRECTORIES TRUE CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${directory}/*")
    endif ()
    set(files)
    foreach (child IN LISTS children)
        if (IS_DIRECTORY "${child}")
            get_filename_component(name "${child}" NAME)
            _ecosystem_asset_cache_directory("${name}" cached)
            if (NOT cached)
                _ecosystem_asset_walk("${project_root}" "${child}" "${ancestors}" nested)
                list(APPEND files ${nested})
            endif ()
        else ()
            _ecosystem_asset_resolve("${project_root}" "${child}" FALSE real_file cached)
            if (NOT cached)
                list(APPEND files "${child}")
            endif ()
        endif ()
    endforeach ()
    set(${result} "${files}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(_ecosystem_runtime_asset_files asset_source result)
    if (NOT EXISTS "${asset_source}" AND NOT IS_SYMLINK "${asset_source}")
        set(${result} "" PARENT_SCOPE)
        return()
    endif ()
    if (NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${asset_source}" OR IS_SYMLINK "${asset_source}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid runtime asset source: ${asset_source}")
    endif ()
    get_filename_component(project_root "${asset_source}/.." REALPATH)
    get_filename_component(real_source "${asset_source}" REALPATH)
    set(files)
    set(allowed_categories brand reports dataset dumps sets templates)
    set(categories ${allowed_categories})
    if (ARGN)
        set(categories ${ARGN})
    endif ()
    foreach (category IN LISTS categories)
        if (NOT category IN_LIST allowed_categories)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid runtime asset category: ${category}")
        endif ()
        if (IS_SYMLINK "${asset_source}/${category}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Runtime asset category uses a symlink: ${category}")
        endif ()
        if (EXISTS "${asset_source}/${category}")
            if (NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${asset_source}/${category}")
                message(FATAL_ERROR "Runtime asset category is not a directory: ${category}")
            endif ()
            _ecosystem_asset_walk("${project_root}" "${asset_source}/${category}" "${real_source}" nested)
            list(APPEND files ${nested})
        endif ()
    endforeach ()
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES files)
    list(SORT files)
    set(${result} "${files}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# Retire only reserved cache directories previously staged by an older surface.
# Never follow output directory aliases or remove similarly named regular files.
function(_ecosystem_prune_asset_caches directory)
    file(GLOB children LIST_DIRECTORIES TRUE "${directory}/*")
    foreach (child IN LISTS children)
        if (IS_DIRECTORY "${child}")
            get_filename_component(name "${child}" NAME)
            _ecosystem_asset_cache_directory("${name}" cached)
            if (cached)
                if (IS_SYMLINK "${child}")
                    file(REMOVE "${child}")
                else ()
                    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${child}")
                endif ()
            elseif (NOT IS_SYMLINK "${child}")
                _ecosystem_prune_asset_caches("${child}")
            endif ()
        endif ()
    endforeach ()
endfunction()

if (NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${asset_source}" OR IS_SYMLINK "${asset_source}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid runtime asset source: ${asset_source}")
endif ()
if (IS_SYMLINK "${asset_destination}" OR
        (EXISTS "${asset_destination}" AND NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${asset_destination}"))
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid runtime asset destination: ${asset_destination}")
endif ()
# Executables beside one another share this output. configure_file replaces
# destination files, so parallel post-build scripts must not copy or prune the
# same tree concurrently. The process lock is destination-local and
# lives beside the payload, not inside it; unrelated destinations stay parallel.
get_filename_component(asset_destination "${asset_destination}" ABSOLUTE)
set(asset_lock "${asset_destination}.lock")
if (IS_SYMLINK "${asset_lock}" OR IS_DIRECTORY "${asset_lock}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid runtime asset staging lock: ${asset_lock}")
endif ()
file(LOCK "${asset_lock}" GUARD PROCESS)
foreach (category IN ITEMS brand reports dataset dumps sets templates)
    if (IS_SYMLINK "${asset_source}/${category}" OR IS_SYMLINK "${asset_destination}/${category}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Runtime asset category uses a symlink: ${category}")
    endif ()
    if (IS_DIRECTORY "${asset_destination}/${category}")
        _ecosystem_prune_asset_caches("${asset_destination}/${category}")
    endif ()
endforeach ()
_ecosystem_runtime_asset_files("${asset_source}" ecosystem_asset_files)
foreach (source IN LISTS ecosystem_asset_files)
    file(RELATIVE_PATH relative "${asset_source}" "${source}")
    get_filename_component(parent "${relative}" DIRECTORY)
    set(destination "${asset_destination}")
    string(REPLACE "/" ";" parents "${parent}")
    foreach (part IN LISTS parents)
        set(destination "${destination}/${part}")
        if (IS_SYMLINK "${destination}" OR
                (EXISTS "${destination}" AND NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${destination}"))
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid runtime asset destination: ${destination}")
        endif ()
    endforeach ()
    if (IS_SYMLINK "${asset_destination}/${relative}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Runtime asset destination uses a symlink: ${relative}")
    endif ()
    # Materialize safe source links; the payload must not depend on source paths.
    configure_file("${source}" "${asset_destination}/${relative}" COPYONLY)
endforeach ()
# Retire media staged by older facades without following a directory alias.
if (IS_SYMLINK "${asset_destination}/showcase")
    file(REMOVE "${asset_destination}/showcase")
else ()
    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${asset_destination}/showcase")
endif ()
]==]
    )
    # A new staging policy must take effect even if application sources did not
    # change. Native Make/Ninja link rules depend on the generated script.
    set_property(TARGET ${target_name} APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ecosystem_assets_${target_name}_$<CONFIG>.cmake")
    add_custom_command(
            TARGET ${target_name} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            "-Dasset_source=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets"
            "-Dasset_destination=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>/assets"
            -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ecosystem_assets_${target_name}_$<CONFIG>.cmake"
            VERBATIM
    )
endfunction()
function(ecosystem_embed_assets target_name)
    if (COMMAND qt_add_resources)
        _ecosystem_runtime_asset_files("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets" ecosystem_asset_files)
        if (ecosystem_asset_files)
            qt_add_resources(${target_name} "kcuckoounter_assets"
                    PREFIX "/kcuckoounter"
                    BASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets"
                    FILES ${ecosystem_asset_files}
            )
        endif ()
    endif ()
endfunction()

_ecosystem_runtime_asset_files("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets" ecosystem_install_assets)
foreach (source IN LISTS ecosystem_install_assets)
    file(RELATIVE_PATH relative "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets" "${source}")
    get_filename_component(parent "${relative}" DIRECTORY)
    get_filename_component(name "${source}" NAME)
    get_filename_component(real_source "${source}" REALPATH)
    install(
            FILES "${real_source}"
            DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/kcuckoounter/assets/${parent}"
            RENAME "${name}"
    )
endforeach ()


if (ECOSYSTEM_PROFILE_ANDROID)
    # This helper is embedded so tracked CMake remains independent of installed Marx.
    function(ecosystem_android_package target source_root config)
        if (CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR STREQUAL source_root)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Android packaging requires a separate build directory")
        endif ()
        find_package(Python3 3.8 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
        set(package_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ecosystem/android/${target}")
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${package_root}")
        file(WRITE "${package_root}/config.json" "${config}")
        file(WRITE "${package_root}/generate_package.py" [=["""Generate a minimal Qt Android overlay; never vendor Qt's runtime package."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ANDROID = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
TOOLS = "http://schemas.android.com/tools"
ET.register_namespace("android", ANDROID)
ET.register_namespace("tools", TOOLS)


def android(name):
    return "{" + ANDROID + "}" + name


def declaration(root, tag, name):
    for child in root.findall(tag):
        if child.get(android("name")) == name:
            return child
    return ET.SubElement(root, tag, {android("name"): name})


def generate_package(template, config, source_root, output, converter=None):
    parser = ET.XMLParser(target=ET.TreeBuilder(insert_comments=True))
    tree = ET.parse(template, parser=parser)
    root = tree.getroot()
    app = root.find("application")
    activity = app.find("activity") if app is not None else None
    if root.tag != "manifest" or app is None or activity is None:
        raise ValueError("Qt Android template lacks manifest/application/activity")
    original = Path(template).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for marker in ("INSERT_VERSION_CODE", "INSERT_VERSION_NAME", "INSERT_APP_NAME",
                   "INSERT_APP_LIB_NAME", "INSERT_APP_ARGUMENTS", "INSERT_PERMISSIONS",
                   "INSERT_FEATURES"):
        token = "%%" + marker + ("" if marker in ("INSERT_PERMISSIONS", "INSERT_FEATURES") else "%%")
        if token not in original:
            raise ValueError("Qt Android template lacks deployment placeholder " + marker)

    root.set("package", config["application_id"])
    for field, attribute in (("allow_backup", "allowBackup"),
                             ("full_backup_content", "fullBackupContent"),
                             ("full_backup_only", "fullBackupOnly"),
                             ("supports_rtl", "supportsRtl")):
        if field in config:
            app.set(android(attribute), str(config[field]).lower())
    if "activity_config_changes" in config:
        activity.set(android("configChanges"), "|".join(config["activity_config_changes"]))

    # Existing declarations also suppress androiddeployqt's automatic additions.
    # tools:node removal additionally prevents a library manifest reintroducing them.
    for permission in config.get("permissions", []):
        declaration(root, "uses-permission", permission)
    for permission in config.get("excluded_permissions", []):
        declaration(root, "uses-permission", permission).set("{" + TOOLS + "}node", "remove")
    for feature in config.get("features", []):
        declaration(root, "uses-feature", feature["name"]).set(
            android("required"), str(feature["required"]).lower())

    icon = config.get("icon")
    if icon:
        source_root = Path(source_root).resolve()
        source = (source_root / icon).resolve()
        source.relative_to(source_root / "assets" / "brand")
        if not source.is_file() or source.suffix != ".svg":
            raise ValueError("Android icon must be an existing assets/brand SVG: " + icon)
        converter = converter or shutil.which("rsvg-convert")
        if not converter:
            raise ValueError("Android SVG launcher generation requires rsvg-convert "
                             "(librsvg); install it or set ECOSYSTEM_ANDROID_SVG_CONVERTER")
        app.set(android("icon"), "@mipmap/ic_launcher")
        if config.get("round_icon", False):
            app.set(android("roundIcon"), "@mipmap/ic_launcher")
    elif config.get("round_icon", False):
        raise ValueError("Android round_icon requires icon metadata")

    output = Path(output)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Keep an existing working overlay intact if template validation or rendering fails.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".package-", dir=output.parent) as temporary:
        staged = Path(temporary)
        if icon:
            for density, size in (("mdpi", 48), ("hdpi", 72), ("xhdpi", 96),
                                  ("xxhdpi", 144), ("xxxhdpi", 192)):
                target = staged / "res" / ("mipmap-" + density) / "ic_launcher.png"
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
                selection = (["--export-id", config["icon_export_id"]]
                             if "icon_export_id" in config else [])
                subprocess.run([str(converter), "--keep-aspect-ratio",
                                "--width", str(size), "--height", str(size),
                                "--page-width", str(size), "--page-height", str(size),
                                "--output", str(target)] + selection + [str(source)], check=True)
                if target.read_bytes()[:8] != b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n":
                    raise ValueError("SVG converter did not produce PNG: " + str(target))
        tree.write(staged / "AndroidManifest.xml", encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
        if output.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(output)
        shutil.copytree(staged, output)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--qt-template", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--config", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--source-root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--svg-converter")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        generate_package(args.qt_template, json.loads(args.config.read_text(encoding="utf-8")),
                         args.source_root, args.output, args.svg_converter)
    except (OSError, ValueError, ET.ParseError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
        parser.exit(1, "ecosystem Android package generation: " + str(error) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
]=])
        get_filename_component(qt_android_root "${Qt6_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
        set(qt_manifest "${qt_android_root}/src/android/templates/AndroidManifest.xml")
        if (NOT EXISTS "${qt_manifest}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Qt Android manifest template is missing: ${qt_manifest}")
        endif ()
        string(JSON icon ERROR_VARIABLE no_icon GET "${config}" icon)
        set(converter_args)
        if (NOT no_icon)
            find_program(ECOSYSTEM_ANDROID_SVG_CONVERTER NAMES rsvg-convert)
            if (NOT ECOSYSTEM_ANDROID_SVG_CONVERTER)
                message(FATAL_ERROR "Android SVG launcher generation requires rsvg-convert (librsvg); install it or set ECOSYSTEM_ANDROID_SVG_CONVERTER")
            endif ()
            list(APPEND converter_args --svg-converter "${ECOSYSTEM_ANDROID_SVG_CONVERTER}")
            set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${source_root}/${icon}")
            set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY QT_ANDROID_APP_ICON "@mipmap/ic_launcher")
        endif ()
        set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${qt_manifest}")
        execute_process(
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${package_root}/generate_package.py"
                --qt-template "${qt_manifest}" --config "${package_root}/config.json"
                --source-root "${source_root}" --output "${package_root}/package"
                ${converter_args}
            RESULT_VARIABLE package_result ERROR_VARIABLE package_error
        )
        if (NOT package_result EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "${package_error}")
        endif ()
        foreach (mapping "application_id|PACKAGE_NAME" "name|APP_NAME"
                         "version_code|VERSION_CODE" "version_name|VERSION_NAME"
                         "min_sdk|MIN_SDK_VERSION" "target_sdk|TARGET_SDK_VERSION")
            string(REPLACE "|" ";" parts "${mapping}")
            list(GET parts 0 field)
            list(GET parts 1 property)
            string(JSON value ERROR_VARIABLE missing GET "${config}" "${field}")
            if (NOT missing)
                if (field STREQUAL "name")
                    # androiddeployqt inserts this value directly into XML attributes.
                    string(REPLACE "&" "&amp;" value "${value}")
                    string(REPLACE "\"" "&quot;" value "${value}")
                    string(REPLACE "'" "&apos;" value "${value}")
                    string(REPLACE "<" "&lt;" value "${value}")
                    string(REPLACE ">" "&gt;" value "${value}")
                endif ()
                set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY "QT_ANDROID_${property}" "${value}")
            endif ()
        endforeach ()
        set_property(TARGET ${target} PROPERTY QT_ANDROID_PACKAGE_SOURCE_DIR "${package_root}/package")
    endfunction()
endif ()

find_package(rasterflow CONFIG REQUIRED)
if (NOT TARGET rasterflow::qt__qt)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Package rasterflow does not export rasterflow::qt__qt; non-facade exports require an installed SDK or Marx preparation")
endif ()
add_library(rasterflow__qt ALIAS rasterflow::qt__qt)

find_package(shared_ui CONFIG REQUIRED)
if (NOT TARGET shared_ui::qt__qt)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Package shared_ui does not export shared_ui::qt__qt; non-facade exports require an installed SDK or Marx preparation")
endif ()
add_library(shared_ui__qt ALIAS shared_ui::qt__qt)

find_package(monitor CONFIG REQUIRED)
if (NOT TARGET monitor::watchdog_client__client)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Package monitor does not export monitor::watchdog_client__client; non-facade exports require an installed SDK or Marx preparation")
endif ()
add_library(watchdog_client__client ALIAS monitor::watchdog_client__client)

find_package(monitor CONFIG REQUIRED)
if (NOT TARGET monitor::watchdog_qt__qt)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Package monitor does not export monitor::watchdog_qt__qt; non-facade exports require an installed SDK or Marx preparation")
endif ()
add_library(watchdog_qt__qt ALIAS monitor::watchdog_qt__qt)

find_package(packing CONFIG REQUIRED)
if (NOT TARGET packing::library__core)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Package packing does not export packing::library__core; non-facade exports require an installed SDK or Marx preparation")
endif ()
add_library(packing_library__core ALIAS packing::library__core)

add_library(trainer_app__core STATIC
    ${KCUCKOOUNTER_TRAINER_APP_CORE_HEADERS}
    ${KCUCKOOUNTER_TRAINER_APP_CORE_SOURCES}
)

target_compile_features(trainer_app__core PUBLIC cxx_std_20)

target_include_directories(trainer_app__core PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/app/include
)

target_link_libraries(trainer_app__core PUBLIC
    Qt6::Concurrent
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Svg
    Qt6::Widgets
    ecosystem_kde_support
    ZLIB::ZLIB
    watchdog_client__client
    packing_library__core
    rasterflow__qt
    shared_ui__qt
)

target_compile_definitions(trainer_app__core PUBLIC $<$<BOOL:${ECOSYSTEM_PROFILE_KDE}>:KC_KDE>)

set_target_properties(trainer_app__core PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME kcuckoounter_core)

ecosystem_apply_defaults(trainer_app__core)

target_compile_definitions(trainer_app__core
        PRIVATE
        ECOSYSTEM_PROJECT_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
)


qt_add_executable(trainer_app__app MANUAL_FINALIZATION
    ${KCUCKOOUNTER_TRAINER_APP_APP_HEADERS}
    ${KCUCKOOUNTER_TRAINER_APP_APP_RUNTIME_SOURCES}
)

target_compile_features(trainer_app__app PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_include_directories(trainer_app__app PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/app/include
)

target_link_libraries(trainer_app__app PRIVATE
    Qt6::Concurrent
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Svg
    Qt6::Widgets
    ecosystem_kde_support
    trainer_app__core
    watchdog_qt__qt
)

target_compile_definitions(trainer_app__app PRIVATE $<$<BOOL:${ECOSYSTEM_PROFILE_KDE}>:KC_KDE>)

set_target_properties(trainer_app__app PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME kcuckoounter)

ecosystem_apply_defaults(trainer_app__app)

target_compile_definitions(trainer_app__app
        PRIVATE
        ECOSYSTEM_PROJECT_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
)

if (ECOSYSTEM_PROFILE_ANDROID)
    if (Qt6_VERSION VERSION_LESS 6.7)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Ecosystem Android packaging requires Qt 6.7 or newer for per-target APK directories")
    endif ()
    set(QT_USE_TARGET_ANDROID_BUILD_DIR ON CACHE BOOL "Keep Android application payloads separate" FORCE)
    if (COMMAND qt_policy)
        qt_policy(SET QTP0002 NEW)
    endif ()
    ecosystem_android_package(trainer_app__app "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" [=[{"name":"Kcuckoounter","version_code":1,"min_sdk":28,"excluded_permissions":["android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE","android.permission.INTERNET","android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"],"allow_backup":false,"full_backup_only":false,"supports_rtl":true,"icon":"assets/brand/logo.svg","application_id":"org.ninjaro.kcuckoounter","version_name":"1.0.0"}]=])
endif ()

ecosystem_embed_assets(trainer_app__app)

qt_finalize_executable(trainer_app__app)

ecosystem_stage_assets(trainer_app__app)


# The visitor name is generated state; the selected target keeps its identity.
# Retire a previous link/copy before a new selection can build at the same path.
foreach(facade_name mvp mvp.exe)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CMakeFiles/ecosystem-${facade_name}.owned")
        file(REMOVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${facade_name}"
                    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CMakeFiles/ecosystem-${facade_name}.owned")
    endif()
endforeach()

get_target_property(ECOSYSTEM_FACADE_TYPE trainer_app__app TYPE)
if(ECOSYSTEM_FACADE_TYPE STREQUAL "EXECUTABLE" AND NOT ANDROID)
    if(WIN32)
        set(ECOSYSTEM_FACADE_NAME mvp.exe)
    else()
        set(ECOSYSTEM_FACADE_NAME mvp)
    endif()
    file(GENERATE
        OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CMakeFiles/ecosystem-facade-$<CONFIG>.cmake"
        CONTENT [=[
set(source "$<TARGET_FILE:trainer_app__app>")
set(destination "${FACADE_DIR}/${FACADE_NAME}")
if(source STREQUAL destination)
    return()
endif()
if(WIN32)
    file(CREATE_LINK "${source}" "${destination}" COPY_ON_ERROR)
else()
    file(RELATIVE_PATH relative "${FACADE_DIR}" "${source}")
    file(CREATE_LINK "${relative}" "${destination}" SYMBOLIC)
endif()
file(WRITE "${FACADE_DIR}/CMakeFiles/ecosystem-${FACADE_NAME}.owned" "generated\n")
]=])
    add_custom_target(_ecosystem_visitor_facade_kcuckoounter ALL
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
            "-DFACADE_DIR=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
            "-DFACADE_NAME=${ECOSYSTEM_FACADE_NAME}"
            -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CMakeFiles/ecosystem-facade-$<CONFIG>.cmake"
        DEPENDS trainer_app__app
        VERBATIM)
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY ADDITIONAL_CLEAN_FILES
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${ECOSYSTEM_FACADE_NAME}"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/CMakeFiles/ecosystem-${ECOSYSTEM_FACADE_NAME}.owned")
endif()

install(TARGETS trainer_app__app
        RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
        LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
        ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
)
